reasons: Compliant status is supported: § 4.1 (p0052) merely points to Service Option Attachments/Order Forms for Charges and contains no pricing-parity, best-terms, or third-party-offer-matching obligation on Customer.
p0200 ('Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others') affirmatively negates any exclusivity/MFN-style constraint, reinforcing the preferred position (no MFN burdening Customer).
Consistent with the rule and claimed status, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed, and the redline output is byte-identical to the original paragraphs; deterministic checks are empty.
Rationale correctly notes that the absence of a Vendor-granted MFN in our favour is not itself a deviation, so no negotiation issue is raised.
